title: Suicide Ultimate
description: This plugin adds suicide to Minecraft. Should support grave datapacks/plugins.
body:
Suicide Ultimate

This plugin adds suicide to Minecraft.

Usage

OPs can use /suicide deathmessage [death message] to change the death message that is sent in chat when player commits suicide. Use %player% placeholder to mention name of the player commiting suicide.

Compatibility

Suicide Ultimate should work on any version from 1.18 to 1.21.11. Java 17 required.

Bugs

If you find any bugs, please message me on discord. My username is @_itsmgxb
